segments.contextAfter: `range`: The range of text to replace. This range is relative to the starting location of the specified context object’s text in your view’s text storage. If you initialized the context object with the entire contents of your view’s text storage, specify the range of text you’re replacing in your text storage. However, if you initialized the context object with only a portion of your view’s text, specify a range that is relative to the starting location of the context object’s text.
